name: Cohort overview
description: What is in a long taxon profile table: samples, subjects, specimen groups, taxa and reads, one summary row per group, one row per subject with its sampling days, and a sampling timeline (subjects against study day, coloured by group). The first page of any cohort report.

inputs.label: Taxon profiles (long)
inputs.description: One row per taxon per sample with read counts. Subject, timepoint and group roles add the per-subject table and the timeline.

rank.title: Taxonomic rank
rank.description: When the table maps a rank role, count taxa of this rank only.

remove_artifacts.title: Remove curated artifacts
remove_artifacts.description: Drop taxa on curation lists with the artifact role before counting reads.

outputs.name: overview
outputs.description: One row per group plus a total row: samples, subjects, taxa, reads.

outputs.name: subjects
outputs.description: One row per subject: groups, samples, timepoints, first and last day.

outputs.name: sampling_timeline
outputs.description: Subjects against study day, one marker per sample, coloured by group.

citation: Built with pandas (McKinney 2010; The pandas development team, https://pandas.pydata.org) and Plotly (Plotly Technologies Inc., https://plotly.com/python/). Cohort counts follow the INDIVO Explorer overview page. See README.md for details.
